channel.title: Global Competition Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Competition Review (globalcompetitionreview.com)

item.title: Cardell: Cloud services up for consideration in soon-to-be-proposed SMS probe
item.description: The cloud services sector is one of several options under consideration as the UK’s Competition and Markets Authority prepares for a potential fourth strategic market status investigation, according to its chief executive.

item.title: Google seeks to quash €76 million Belgian penalty
item.description: Google has urged a Belgian appellate court to ignore competition law arguments from an advertising start-up, as the technology company seeks to quash a €76 million penalty for failing to restore access to its ad exchange for over three days.

item.title: Arm and a leg: The Tipline for 5 February 2026
item.description: Medtronic is on the hook for $382 million for illegally monopolising certain blood vessel instruments through bundling and exclusive dealing. The 10-day trial concluded on Friday, with the California federal jury accepting the damages estimate of Applied Materials’ hired expert, Econic Partners founder Jon Orszag. item.title: Whistleblower bar expecting wave of antitrust work after first award
item.description: The rapid rollout and promotion of the Department of Justice’s new antitrust informant regime has whistleblower specialists anticipating an influx of work.

item.title: Pitfalls: The Briefing for 6 February 2026
item.description: Rio Tinto and Glencore’s confirmation that the mining giants have abandoned talks of a potential mega-deal means competition agencies no longer need to be on standby. Any tie-up between two of the world’s largest companies in the sector would almost certainly have attracted regulatory scrutiny, but the businesses exited talks after finding the transaction could not provide shareholder value. item.title: Mexican enforcer launches first in-depth market investigation
item.description: Mexico’s National Antitrust Commission has proposed sweeping legislative reforms and mandatory divestments by the country’s largest rail freight operator as part of its first-ever preliminary market investigation report.

item.title: Gender gap narrows at partner level across world’s best competition practices
item.description: The average number of women partners working within the world’s best antitrust practices increased in 2025 compared to 2024, with the number of female competition specialist associates also climbing slightly.

item.title: Smoke-filled rooms: The Tipline for 6 February 2026
item.description: Ohio attorney general David Yost has accused nine cannabis companies of illegally coordinating shelf space with one another. The Buckeye State said its consumers pay more than other parts of the US because the “cannabis cartel” allegedly conspired to eliminate local competitors and maintain high prices. item.title: Zillow defeats Compass listing challenge
item.description: Compass failed to demonstrate that Zillow is an illegal monopolist that conspired with Redfin to boycott rival real estate listings, a Manhattan federal judge has ruled in rejecting its bid for a preliminary injunction.

item.title: Cleary, Kirkland and Skadden handled toughest deals in 2025
item.description: Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton, Kirkland & Ellis and Skadden Arps Slate Meagher & Flom represented the most companies facing in-depth merger reviews before the US antitrust agencies in 2025, according to a GCR analysis.
